URL: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/18/trump-iran-attack-saudi-uae-qatar-deal.html
TITLE: Trump says he's postponing Iran attack at Middle East leaders' request
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-18 evening US time

KEY (Trump Truth Social post):
- "We will NOT be doing the scheduled attack of Iran tomorrow"
- "I was asked by Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE, and some others if we could put it off for two or three days, a short period of time"
- Gulf leaders believe US-Iran can reach a deal "very acceptable to the United States"
- US military instructed to remain prepared for "full, large-scale assault" on short notice

CONTEXT:
- Attack was scheduled for Tuesday May 19
- Trump posted late evening Monday US time
- US military, including Defence Secretary Hegseth and Chairman JCS Gen Caine, on standby
- Reuters reported Pakistan handed US revised Iranian proposal earlier Monday
- Iran's proposal does not commit to suspending uranium enrichment or handing over HEU stockpile per Axios senior US official

CNN reporting (https://www.cnn.com/2026/05/18/politics/trump-iran-resumed-attack-plans):
- Trump: "I was asked by Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE, and some others if we could put it off for two or three days, a short period of time, because they..."
- The pause is presented as a final window for negotiations
